audit_repair.reason: The historical DARG Best checkpoint pickle refers to numpy._core.multiarray, unavailable in the NumPy 1.26 runtime. In addition, numpy.random state pickle bytes differ between NumPy 1.26 and NumPy 2.2.6 even when the RNG state and consumption are identical. The audit now uses a separate NumPy 2 extraction for only DARG predictions and metrics and replays each public forward/evaluation RNG trajectory with NumPy-2-compatible hash serialization. It verifies original checkpoint SHA and independently recomputes all metrics in the primary runtime.

research_assessment.single_seed_limitation: one seed is preliminary candidate evidence, not final MICCAI evidence
